gates.evidence: Phase 5 tests preserve exact request, workload, session, graph, provider, model_id, family, and revision identities.
Composition candidates preserve immutable Phase 2 through Phase 4 provenance and merge duplicate provenance deterministically.
Validation rejects incompatible modality, structured, retrieval, tool, capability, and explicit-evidence handoffs.
Certified patterns, exact model identities, signatures, canonical collections, and bounded enumeration have deterministic test coverage.
Malformed upstream state, unsupported topology, invalid DAGs, missing evidence, incompatible records, and no-valid required composition fail closed.
Phase 5 rejects ranking, selection, graph assignment, fallback, free-form topology, recursion, hardware, placement, scheduler, runtime, optimization, and nested decision leakage.
